response.sql: WITH per_order AS (SELECT ordersmark, AVG(fillcount) AS avg_fill_size FROM orderexecutions GROUP BY ordersmark), first_benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(avg_fill_size) AS benchmark FROM per_order), above_first AS (SELECT p.ordersmark, p.avg_fill_size, p.avg_fill_size - b.benchmark AS first_margin FROM per_order p CROSS JOIN first_benchmark b WHERE p.avg_fill_size > b.benchmark), second_benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(avg_fill_size) AS benchmark FROM above_first), final_orders AS (SELECT a.avg_fill_size, a.first_margin, a.avg_fill_size - b.benchmark AS second_margin FROM above_first a CROSS JOIN second_benchmark b WHERE a.avg_fill_size > b.benchmark) SELECT AVG(avg_fill_size) AS avg_per_order_fill_size, AVG(first_margin) AS avg_first_margin, AVG(second_margin) AS avg_second_margin FROM final_orders

assumptions.assumption: Each distinct ordersmark, including NULL as one group, counts equally in both benchmarks. SQL AVG ignores NULL fillcount values.
